item.title: Home for Good event promotes second chances for ex-prisoners
item.description: <p>When Andre Ruddock was born, doctors told his family they didn't think he would live.</p><p>Ruddock had health problems because his mother was addicted to heroin when she was pregnant with him. </p><p>“Obviously, I made it, but that's how I ended up as a ward of the state in the Department of Children and Family Services,” said Ruddock, 49, who grew up on the South Side.</p><p>He doesn’t see his upbringing as a sad story. He got to interact with many different people from diverse backgrounds.
